title: Jump Game
description: You start at index `0` of `nums`, where `nums[i]` is the maximum number of positions you may jump forward from index `i`. Return `true` if you can reach the last index, otherwise `false`.

examples.explanation: Jump 1 to index 1, then 2 to index 3, then 1 to index 4.
Every path ends stuck on the 0 at index 3.

hints: Trying every jump choice can be exponential. Instead of which path, ask which indices are reachable at all.
Track the farthest index reachable so far. Any index at or before it is also reachable.
Scan left to right: if the current index exceeds the farthest reach, return false; otherwise farthest = max(farthest, i + nums[i]).
starterCode:
class Solution:
    def canJump(self, nums: List[int]) -> bool:

solution.explanation: Greedily track the farthest index reachable. Walk the array; if the current index is beyond that farthest reach, you are stuck and the answer is false. Otherwise extend the reach with i + nums[i]. If the scan finishes, the last index is reachable. Single pass, O(n) time and O(1) space.
